product_brief: Rust implementation of post-quantum cryptography algorithms with no_std support.
pqc_capability_description: Rust implementation of post-quantum cryptography algorithms with no_std support. Supports LMS (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-KEM (EncapDecap, KeyGen), and SLH-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer). Validated on Raspberry Pi OS (Debian 12) in ARM Cortex-A76.
crypto_primitives: LMS, ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA, SHA2-256, SHA2-384, SHA2-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256
primary_platforms: Raspberry Pi OS (Debian 12) in ARM Cortex-A76
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Validated on ARM Cortex-A76; supports no_std.
